requirements.question: Where are national or regional internet connectivity, BGP routing, or public communications networks degraded or shut down worldwide?
Which countries or autonomous systems (ASNs) are experiencing a >=25% drop in BGP reachable prefixes or active probing responsiveness?
Where are simultaneous multi-country BGP drops consistent with a submarine cable cut or landing-station fault rather than a domestic policy shutdown?
Where is application-layer censorship (OONI confirmed blocks or TLS/DNS anomalies >=15%) surging ahead of or alongside connectivity curfews?
What is the percentage drop from the 7-day baseline across BGP visibility and active probing (Ping-Slash24) for the affected country or ASN?
Which submarine cable systems and landing stations serve the simultaneously degraded countries?

Is a major cloud, content, network or satellite internet provider (Starlink, Amazon, Microsoft, Google, Apple, Cloudflare, Akamai, Slack, Zoom) down at the network level, or reporting an open incident, and are several down at once?
What is the BGP and active-probing drop on each watched provider network against the 7 days before, and over what window?
Which incidents does each provider list as open on its own status feed, since when, and in which regions?
Whose address space is another network originating (a BGP hijack), or whose routes are leaking through a customer, widely enough to divert or blackhole traffic?
Which prefixes, origin networks and path are involved, at what Cloudflare confidence and on what evidence (RPKI, IRR, sibling origins), seen by how many route collectors, and since when?
Where have people or critical sites lost grid power, and which internet outages does a loss of power explain?
Does the Zaporizhzhya Nuclear Power Plant have off-site power, through how many lines, and how many complete losses of off-site power has the IAEA counted?
Which internet outages does Cloudflare attribute to a power outage, and where?
How many shutdowns has Access Now documented in the country in the last full year, for what stated causes, and how recently? (History for context; it never decides the cause of a current outage.)
Where in the US are more than 50,000 customers without power, by state and county, among the utilities that report to ODIN?
Which watched cities are much darker at night than on their own recent clear nights, by how much, and how much of each city could the satellite see?
Which US balancing authorities served far less demand than their own day-ahead forecasts implied, for how many hours, by how much, and when?
What did OONI test in the country: how many URLs Citizen Lab's test list holds there, in which categories, and how recently it was updated? (Context for an OONI rate; it never decides a judgment.)
Which national systems that US travel and commerce run on have stopped working (air traffic control, an airline's own systems, a major software or platform provider), when, and for how long?

Has the FAA stopped departures for every airport, for a whole airline, at an airline's request at several airports at once, or at an airport for an equipment or communications outage; when, where and for how long?
